notes.title: 11.21 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss in [b]Round 40[/b] could not be attacked.
[*] We apologize for not being able to address an issue that significantly impacted gameplay in a timely manner.
[*] As compensation, we have awarded all users 10,000 CP. We will continue to strive for better service in the future.
[/list]

[list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]drag box[/b] was not functioning.
[*] Added a [b]camera zoom-in[/b] feature using the scroll wheel.
[*] Enabled screen switching using [b]F1[/b] to [b]F5[/b] keys.
[*] Added the ability to assign units using [b]Ctrl[/b] + [b]1[/b] to [b]0[/b] keys.
[/list]

[list]
[h3]Performance Adjustments[/h3]
[*] Identified that [b]buff characters[/b] (Emia, Fukiko) showed excessively high performance when their [b]attack speed[/b] buffs were [b]stacked[/b].
[*] Adjusted attack speed buffs so they cannot exceed three times the buffing character's attack speed.
[/list]
